metadata.title: EGGPU Dataset Provenance Manifest
metadata.description: Source records, exact checksums, graph semantics, and redistribution boundaries for the 13 graph inputs used in the EGGPU paper. This draft describes a provenance-manifest deposit; it does not authorize redistribution of third-party graph files.

creators.name: Wang, Xinming
creators.affiliation: Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences

excluded_until_rights_review: all SNAP-origin graph files and derived copies
ER-100k.txt until the authors assign a dataset license

conditions: credit the SuiteSparse Matrix Collection and original graph authors
preserve the source metadata and dataset-specific citations
identify every transformed artifact with a new name
document row retention, index conversion, weight semantics, and CSR conversion

required_before_deposition: confirm the final creator order and affiliations
resolve every UNKNOWN redistribution field for any graph bytes to be uploaded
choose and record a license for the manifest itself
add the final paper DOI or bibliographic identifier
recompute checksums for the exact files selected for upload
